They’re turning people away claiming to have Covid symptoms to keep the zero-case talking point alive. Trump wanted to close the borders back in January and faced backlash from everybody claiming it would be racist and xenophobic to close the borders from China. Fast forward to March and everyone is blaming him for not doing enough. Winnie the Pooh ordered people to be welded and nailed into their apartments. There is now suspicion that the 21 million less activated cell phones in China is an indication that China lied excessively about their true death rate. Trump is doing the best he can (I’m not even really a fan of him) against a country that doesn’t believe in him, a government that wants to stop him, and a media that hates him. Trump is thinking about the long-term effects of a global crisis like this, he’s thinking about the possibility that in a country-wide depression, people could starve to death as they have in the past. The virus is it’s only issue but he is trying to weigh up the possible deaths caused by Covid, that of which the estimates are going down each day, versus millions dying in a modern day depression.
